# Supertext SDK (bundled copy)

Built JavaScript of the TypeScript part of the [Supertext SDK](https://github.com/Supertext/Supertext-API-SDK-and-Guide) (`sdk/typescript`), version 0.2.0, commit `c66cb4d497a6c354688e6e5783ce0863473dfa65`. `package.json` makes it the `supertext-sdk` devDependency that the extension build bundles into `dist/`.

Don't edit these files: fix the SDK in its own repository, then run `scripts/vendor-sdk.sh`.
